reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, as deep learning potentials trained on ab initio data are known to better capture complex many-body interactions and configurational diversity than EAM potentials, directly addressing the phase-space overlap problem in thermodynamic integration.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and decisive, with a specific quantitative falsification criterion (≥30% reduction in TI path mismatch), though practical execution on a 5-component carbide at 3000-3600 K is computationally extremely demanding.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is highly useful, proposing a concrete methodological intervention with a well-defined benchmark and quantitative prediction, directly addressing the core challenge of the research question.
